feature_contract.goal: Keep original OutRun Present source aspect and both-eye HUD containment coherent across Reset and resize while eliminating duplicate R29 state snapshot on cache misses.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: DX9Ex R30 HUD cache and source aspect only. World, SkyGlow, menus, FFB, DX11 and DXVK unaffected.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: R30 HUD cache misses capture full frame twice: one read for cache identity and another for aspect. Game resize between reads risks mixed-generation ratio; prior Quest3 trace showed maximum 3929.3 draw calls per Present. FPS benefit unmeasured.
trace_stages: Original OutRun D3D9 backbuffer updates dimensions during Present and Reset.
R29 HUD frame snapshot publishes cache identity including game source width height and epoch.
R30 ratio maps game source aspect to both XR eye extents in XYZRHW and shader draw paths.
subcomponents: Use original cache-key width and height for all R30 aspect calculations and remove redundant second frame capture.
Preserve per-eye XR extent reevaluation and zero-size/reset fallback rather than freezing VR pose or viewport.
Extend existing CI HUD verifier with aspect math and five negative source mutations.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Cache key and computed aspect refer to identical Present source dimensions.
Zero-size frame and Reset reject stale cache while live XR eye-extent/FOV changes remain effective.
Existing/new regression scripts and exact-SHA DX9Ex Active, Domain Isolation, Full Source Impact must pass.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R30HudContainScale calls R29OwnerCaptureFrameSnapshot and R30HudAspectCompensation independently called it again.
diagnosis.root_cause: A game Reset/resize can interleave reads and persist a new-generation aspect under an old source-dimension cache key.
source_trace: OutRun original D3D9 game RT source and Present epoch
R29 captured frame for R30 HUD cache identity
R30 source/eye aspect applied to both stereo HUD render paths
alternatives_rejected: Never freeze host XR recommended eye extent when it changes without game Present.
Never change world draw stereo or SkyGlow effects.
Never modify menus and F11 external ImGui render source.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Verified on exact-SHA DX9Ex Active policy: 3 source aspect seeds; 5 negative snapshot/cache mutants; amended legacy R30 snapshot owner guard, plus existing comprehensive HUD, world and eye-context regressions.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Forward caller frame dimensions and eliminate second full frame snapshot call.

full_source_impact.note: Source-impact review ran on latest C++ material repair SHA. Subsequent validation-bearing change updates only the Python verifier; compiled C++ matches material SHA.
